position_is_previously_bonused.meaning: the locked position being converted is an existing smNFT or a previously bonused position

conversion_applies_one_time_bonus.meaning: converting a regular locked position to an smNFT applies the bonus exactly once (no additional bonus on an already-bonused position)

multiple_conversions_accumulate_excess_b.meaning: sophisticated users trigger multiple conversions and thereby accumulate excess bonuses beyond the one-time bonus

claims.scope: Sophisticated users could potentially trigger multiple conversions to accumulate excess bonuses

preconditions.text: A user converts an existing smNFT or a previously bonused position.
preconditions.derivation: Program conjunction of selected report preconditions.

safety.text: Converting a regular locked position to an smNFT should apply a one-time bonus.
safety.derivation: Program synthesis from the selected intent and logical pattern.

effects.text: Sophisticated users could potentially trigger multiple conversions to accumulate excess bonuses
effects.derivation: Program-generated direct negation witness for the selected safety pattern.

effect_coverage.reason: Program-generated exact coverage for selected direct impact.

assumptions: The one-time bonus requirement is scoped to conversions of regular locked positions; the report does not give a numeric bonus formula.

limitations: Bonus amounts and smNFT balance values are not numerically specified in the report; stage-3 binding must map the Boolean observables to concrete state.
